notes: Car H - ecosystem: one-click skills and a self-hosted outbound proxy. The console's Skills view became two panes: an OFFICIAL CATALOG browser (six category chips, availability chips from the requires projection, one-click INSTALL from the staged packages that ship with this release - a local file copy, zero network, no execution, no third-party source) and the mounted armory, where every skill carries an on/off switch (installed but never loads - the deterministic router filters settings.skills.disabled fail-soft) and one-click-installed skills can be removed (the shipped overlay is never written by any console action). New Bearer-gated endpoints POST /api/skills/{install,uninstall,toggle} are deny-by-default on the slug (404 not-in-catalog, 409 bundled/already-installed/package-missing, 400 malformed - values never echoed), and the gallery now resolves from the router's own ladder: source in body/external/learned/installed plus enabled, so what you see is exactly what routes. Item #8 shipped as the outbound-proxy skill PLUS a real product seam: settings outbound_proxy routes aidog's own http_fetch through a proxy YOU host - off by default, fail-closed once enabled (a proxy failure is an honest word, never a silent direct retry), TEST endpoint with the documented reason words (refused/timeout/tls/dns/auth/bad_url/unreachable), credentials kept in the AIDOG_PROXY_AUTH slot because settings.json carries none by design (the model-facing settings get reads that file), and an https target through an authenticated proxy refuses with the auth word instead of leaking the credential into the CONNECT tunnel. New truth-parity gate: the public skills repo, the site catalog, the staged packages and the bundled overlay must match byte for byte (honest SKIP on a clean export).
